name: clean-contract-errors-and-screenshot-revision
goal: Hide empty contract errors and label screenshots by their capture commit.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: EntityContracts always render an empty Errors group; callable and service builders render empty Throws groups; summaries emit Fails with despite errors=[]; the screenshot pane labels scope.commit instead of its existing Evidence.source capture revision.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The standardized contract tests asserted empty-error copy or omitted only Inputs/Outputs; screenshot browser coverage asserted images but not figcaptions. Extend entity-preview-contract and entity-preview plus shared service contract tests to assert empty groups are absent and inherited captures are labelled with Evidence.source.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
